notes: The quoted text is only the chapter colophon (adhyāyapuṣpikā) of Devīmāhātmya ch. 13 (Mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇa). It names no human persons, gives no date and no place. The catalogue fields list a scribe ('Gaurīdatta Trivikramarāja ?') and a date ('SAM (ŚS) 1841'), but neither appears in this excerpt. They presumably come from elsewhere in the manuscript. If the date is really ŚS 1841, it would be about 1919 CE. A bare 'saṃ 1841' could also be VS, which would give about 1784 CE. The catalogue's own question mark shows that the scribe's name is uncertain.
